name: Godrej & Boyce Mfg. Co. Ltd.
description: Godrej & Boyce is one of India's most diversified engineering companies, part of the 127-year-old Godrej Group. The manufacturing division produces everything from security solutions (locks, safes) to aerospace components, material handling equipment, and precision engineering parts.
honest_assessment: Excellent for security products (locks, safes, access control) and storage solutions (industrial shelving, warehouse systems). Their tooling and precision engineering division is underrated - capable of complex die-cast and sheet metal work. For B2B, the sweet spot is storage/material handling systems where they dominate the Indian market. Avoid their consumer appliances division for B2B - that's a separate entity (Godrej Appliances). Pricing is fair but not the cheapest; you pay for the brand and reliability.
